SELECT: n.primary_name, AVG(actor作品评分) AS actor_avg_rating, AVG(director作品评分) AS director_avg_rating
FROM: names n, principals p, titles t
WHERE: p.category_id IN ('actor','actress') OR p.category_id = 'director'; t.title_type = 'movie'; t.average_rating IS NOT NULL
HAVING: 该人物同时拥有 actor 作品和 director 作品（两种角色都至少有一部作品）
LIMIT: 通过 run_sql limit 参数控制
